primaryChecks.text: Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza; and Amon his son reigned in his place.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
primaryChecks.nextContext: Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Meshullemeth the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 21:18は「自分の家の庭、ウザの園」に葬られたと記す。21:26はアモンもウザの園に葬られたと記す。宮殿付属とは述べない。

primaryChecks.text: He was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza, and Josiah his son reigned in his place.
